# Child Mind Institute

> A leading nonprofit organization transforming children's mental health and learning through clinical services, evidence-based research, and family education.

Child Mind Institute provides comprehensive mental health care for children and teens across multiple locations in New York, California, and New Jersey. The organization combines clinical services with cutting-edge neuroscience research, including the Healthy Brain Network initiative, and offers school-based programs and family resources.

## Key Topics

- Children's Mental Health
- ADHD
- Autism Spectrum Disorder
- Anxiety and Depression
- Neuroscience Research
- Healthy Brain Network
- Evidence-Based Treatment
- Learning Disorders
- Parent Education
- School Mental Health Programs
- Behavioral Health
- Clinical Services
- Youth Mental Health Academy
- Brain Imaging
- Family Resources

## Mental Health Care Services

- [Mental Health Care at the Child Mind Institute](https://childmind.org/care): Mental health care services for children and teens with ADHD, anxiety, depression, and mood disorders
- [Request an Appointment - Child Mind Institute](https://childmind.org/care/request-appointment): Appointment scheduling form for mental health services at CMI locations
- [ADHD & Behavior After-School Program - Child Mind Institute](https://childmind.org/care/programs/adhd-and-behavior-after-school-program): 8-week ADHD and behavior management program for ages 4-10 with related disorders

## Education & Community Programs

- [School and Community Programs - Child Mind Institute](https://childmind.org/school-and-community): Evidence-based school mental health programs and educator training in California and Queens
- [Youth Mental Health Academy - Become an Internship Host](https://childmind.org/youth-mental-health-academy/opportunities-for-professionals): Internship hosting opportunities for professionals in Youth Mental Health Academy program

## Research & Science

- [Science at the Child Mind Institute](https://childmind.org/science): Research overview: neuroscience, brain imaging, biomarkers, and Healthy Brain Network
- [Children's Brain Activity Shows Shift from Sensory to Cognitive Processing as They Mature](https://childmind.org/blog/childrens-brain-activity-shows-shift-from-sensory-to-cognitive-processing-as-they-mature): Research findings on brain development from childhood to adulthood using novel analysis methods
- [How We Built Responsible AI in Mirror Journal](https://childmind.org/blog/how-we-built-responsible-ai-in-mirror-journal): Mirror digital journaling app development: responsible AI, ethics, and clinical validation

## Parent Resources & Guides

- [Resources for National Reading Month](https://childmind.org/resources/national-reading-month): Reading instruction guide covering phonics, dyslexia resources, and literacy tips for parents
- [Teens and Online Gambling](https://childmind.org/article/teens-and-online-gambling): Parent guide on teen online gambling risks, warning signs, and conversation strategies
- [Pathological Demand Avoidance (PDA) in Kids](https://childmind.org/article/pathological-demand-avoidance-in-kids): Article explaining PDA autism spectrum behavior pattern and parenting strategies
- [Get Prom Ready | Prom Resources for Parents and Teens](https://childmind.org/prom): Guide with tips and expert guidance for supporting teen mental health around prom events

## Organization Information

- [Child Mind Institute | Transforming Children's Lives](https://childmind.org): Child Mind Institute homepage: nonprofit transforming children's mental health and learning disorders
- [About Us - Child Mind Institute](https://childmind.org/about-us): Organizational overview: mission, vision, locations across NYC, SF Bay Area, NJ, and NY
